exposure: presence of a doula during labor

maternal health conditions (anemia, diabetes, preeclampsia, prolonged rupture of membrane, placenta abruption, presence of meconium in amniotic fluid, intrauterine growth retardation, intrauterine fetal death)
cohort: The study participants were women who had vaginal deliveries of a single pregnancy, excluding scheduled/emergency cesarean sections, at a tertiary-care medical center.
finding: Linear regression demonstrated the best predictive performance (AUC: 0.85) among machine learning models for episiotomy, identifying parity, labor onset, gestational age, body mass index, and doula support as key related clinical factors.
